text:
Alex: Quick async standup — short check for SDKs/quickstarts and sample apps
What I did: upgraded TypeScript -> 5.2 and bumped @redwood/sdk to 2.4.1, fixed a couple of typed exports in sample-embedder.
Blockers: CI on macOS keeps failing on native grpc in the embedder tests (failing in CI wheel build).
Today: opening a dep-pin + fallback PR, will try swapping to @grpc/grpc-js if rebuilds don't work. Can someone review later?

Priya: thanks for the heads-up. can you paste the failing snippet so I can triage?

Alex: here's the crucial part:
```
Error: dlopen(/workspace/node_modules/grpc/build/Release/grpc.node, 1): Library not loaded: @rpath/grpc.framework/Versions/A/grpc
  Referenced from: /usr/local/lib/node_modules/...
  Reason: image not found
```

Jordan: that's the usual mac native-binary issue. quick checks: try `npm ci` then `npm rebuild --build-from-source grpc` or switch the sample to `@grpc/grpc-js` which is pure JS.

Alex: trying `@grpc/grpc-js` locally now, if green I'll update the sample and quickstart snippet.

Maria: I also ran docs lint last night — a few heading levels and one broken link in quickstarts. I'll open a tiny PR with fixes and a changelog note.

DevEx Bot: CI queued — repo: redwood/samples/embedder — run_id: 6421 — status: queued (1754322020)

Priya: heads-up: CLI v2 changed the `--example` flag behavior, quickstart snippets in docs need `--template` instead. I'll add inline comments in the docs PR so we don't regress users.

Alex: great. @Maria @Priya please take code + doc reviews when ready — I'll mark the dep PR WIP until tests pass. If anyone runs into the mac build, DM me; I can provide a mac debug runner.

Jordan: ack. also tiny suggestion: change `yarn start:sample` -> `yarn dev:sample` in the quickstart to match script rename. saves confusion for new users. :nerd_face:

Alex: noted, will include that in the PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
